key_insights: Why it matters: The work shows that genome models can move beyond generating individual DNA sequences to designing complete bacteriophage genomes.
What changed: Large genome models previously shown to generate protein-coding DNA were used to produce genomes of viruses that infect bacteria.
What to watch: Further evidence is needed about laboratory viability, capabilities beyond close variants of existing viruses, and the safety controls applied to this research.
